faq.question: Can I copy the path to a specific value?
faq.answer: Yes, click on any node to copy its JSON path (e.g., user.profile.name). This is useful when working with JSONPath expressions or accessing nested data in code.

faq.question: Can I search within the JSON tree?
faq.answer: Yes, use the search box to filter nodes by key name or value. Matching nodes and their parents are highlighted, making it easy to find specific data in large JSON structures.

faq.question: Can I export the tree structure?
faq.answer: Yes. After viewing the tree, you can download the expanded structure as a text file. This is useful for documentation or sharing the structure with your team.

faq.question: Does it show image previews?
faq.answer: Yes. When the tree contains image URLs, hovering over them shows instant previews. This helps verify image links without leaving the viewer.

faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser. Your JSON data never leaves your device. The tree viewer runs entirely client-side.

faq.question: What is the difference between a JSON tree viewer and a JSON formatter?
faq.answer: A JSON formatter displays JSON as indented text. A tree viewer displays JSON as an interactive expandable/collapsible tree structure, making it easier to navigate deeply nested data and understand the overall structure at a glance.

faq.question: Is this a free online JSON viewer and explorer?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free json online viewer, json viewer online, and json explorer tool. You can view, explore, and visualize any JSON data directly in your browser — no upload required.

article.title: How to View JSON Data as an Interactive Tree
article.content:
Why Use a JSON Tree Viewer?

JSON data can be complex and deeply nested. A tree viewer transforms raw JSON into an interactive, visual structure that's easy to understand and navigate. Instead of scrolling through hundreds of lines of text, you can expand and collapse nodes to focus on the data you need.

Key Features

  • Interactive Tree: Click to expand/collapse any node
  • Search: Find keys or values instantly
  • Copy Paths: Click any node to copy its JSON path
  • Image Preview: Hover over image URLs to see previews

How to Use

  1. Paste JSON into the input field
  2. Click View Tree to generate the tree
  3. Explore: Click nodes to expand/collapse
  4. Search: Use the search box to find specific data
  5. Copy: Click any node to copy its path

Common Use Cases

  • API Exploration: Understand complex API response structures
  • Config Files: Navigate nested configuration objects
  • Data Analysis: Explore large JSON datasets
  • Debugging: Inspect JSON data structure issues

Tips

  • Use search: For large JSON, search is faster than manual navigation
  • Copy paths: Useful for JSONPath queries or code references
  • Check image URLs: Hover to verify image links

article.title: 如何以交互式树形查看 JSON 数据
article.content:
为什么使用 JSON 树形查看器？

JSON 数据可能复杂且深度嵌套。树形查看器将原始 JSON 转换为易于理解和导航的交互式可视化结构。无需滚动数百行文本，只需展开和折叠节点即可专注于所需数据。

主要功能

  • 交互式树：点击展开/折叠任意节点
  • 搜索：即时查找键或值
  • 复制路径：点击任意节点复制其 JSON 路径
  • 图片预览：悬停在图片 URL 上查看预览

使用方法

  1. 粘贴 JSON 到输入框
  2. 点击查看树 生成树形视图
  3. 探索：点击节点展开/折叠
  4. 搜索：使用搜索框查找特定数据
  5. 复制：点击任意节点复制其路径

常见使用场景

  • API 探索：理解复杂的 API 响应结构
  • 配置文件：导航嵌套的配置对象
  • 数据分析：探索大型 JSON 数据集
  • 调试：检查 JSON 数据结构问题

技巧

  • 使用搜索：对于大型 JSON，搜索比手动导航更快
  • 复制路径：对 JSONPath 查询或代码引用很有用
  • 检查图片 URL：悬停以验证图片链接
